metrics.name: Thaana under the shipped tokenizer
metrics.value: 84.9% of Thaana source characters fall inside an <unk> token and are unrecoverable, against 0.1% for the same sentences in Malé Latin. This is why the pipeline romanizes before it models.

metrics.name: Tokenizers compared
metrics.value: t5-small and the shipped trimmed tokenizer lose Thaana entirely; NLLB-200 (79.2% lost) carries exactly one Thaana codepoint in a 256,204-entry vocabulary; mT5-small and ByT5-small cover Thaana at 0.0% loss, at 1.2 GB and 1.2 GB of fp32 weights respectively — 17x the browser budget
